summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K reporting the results of a tender offer for up to $850M of its 4.750% Non-Step-Up Non-Cumulative Contingent Convertible Perpetual Preferred Tier 1 Securities. A total of $701.6M aggregate principal amount was validly tendered and accepted at a purchase price of $1,001 per $1,000 principal amount (100.1% of par), with no proration. Settlement is June 11, 2026, and accepted securities will be cancelled, leaving $298.4M outstanding. D.F. King served as tender agent for Banco Santander, and Santander US Capital Markets was dealer manager. Note that this is a buyback of own perpetual preferred securities—an issuer tender to manage capital structure—not a conventional debt tender. Watch for whether remaining securities are called or remain outstanding.
